name: fintech-payout-go
idea: Regulated merchant payout ledger for treasury operators to approve, post and reconcile cross-border EUR wire settlements with immutable audit records instead of manual CSV banking batches.
rules: When a payout exceeds 1000000 euro cents, the ledger shall require a distinct second treasury approver before posting.
When a settlement request reuses an idempotency key with altered parameters, the ledger shall reject the transfer with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
